punchline: A Roman emperor facing war, plague and a rebellion wrote in his private notebook that what stands in the way becomes the way.
thirty_sec: Marcus Aurelius ran the Roman Empire through nearly nonstop war, a devastating plague and a general who tried to seize power. The whole time, he kept a private journal in Greek, just reminders to himself, never meant to be published. In it he wrote that what stands in the way becomes the way. Ryan Holiday built a whole book on that line: an obstacle isn't only a wall, it can be the raw material for your next move.
question: Has an obstacle ever pushed you onto a path you ended up glad you took?
